defects.description: The Pod's configMapKeyRef names ConfigMap `app-config`, but the ConfigMap defined in this manifest is named `special-config`; no `app-config` exists.
paraphrases: configMapKeyRef points at `app-config`, but only `special-config` is defined.
The referenced ConfigMap name should be `special-config`, not `app-config`.
Dangling ConfigMap reference: `app-config` is never defined.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the configMapKeyRef name (line 24) to the ConfigMap metadata.name (line 4); should be special-config.

defects.description: The configMapKeyRef requests key `SPECIAL_MODE`, but the ConfigMap only defines keys `SPECIAL_LEVEL` and `SPECIAL_TYPE`.
paraphrases: The key `SPECIAL_MODE` does not exist in the ConfigMap (which has SPECIAL_LEVEL and SPECIAL_TYPE).
configMapKeyRef.key should be one of the defined keys, not `SPECIAL_MODE`.
Dangling key reference: `SPECIAL_MODE` is not in the ConfigMap data.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the referenced key (line 25) to the ConfigMap data keys (lines 7-8).

defects.description: The Pod is in namespace `production`, but the ConfigMap it references is in namespace `default`; ConfigMaps are namespace-scoped, so the reference cannot resolve across namespaces.
paraphrases: The Pod (namespace production) cannot reference a ConfigMap in namespace default.
Namespace mismatch: the ConfigMap is in `default` but the Pod is in `production`.
A namespaced ConfigMap reference only works within the same namespace.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the Pod namespace (line 14) to the ConfigMap namespace (line 5); should be default.
